result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

The difference comes down to whether you prioritize ease of use or value for money.

## My top 4 picks

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

(My top recommendation)

- Excellent user experience
- Easy sharing of team credentials
- Separate vaults for departments and projects
- Strong admin controls and access management
- Good for nontechnical teams

Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users. Business: \$8.99/user/month.

[1Password Business](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Open-source core
- Strong security features
- Shared collections for team passwords
- Admin controls and audit logs
- Good for technically capable teams

Teams: approximately \$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best budget option**

- Business admin console
- Secure shared folders
- Good access management
- Additional security products available

Business Starter: approximately \$2/user/month, billed annually, for 5–10 users.

[Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane — Best security monitoring**

- Password health monitoring
- Security alerts
- Centralized administration
- Good employee-facing experience

Business pricing starts around \$8/user/month for the compared plan.

[Dashlane Business](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Prices are approximate published annual-billing rates as of November 2026. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Quick comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Good |
| Team sharing | Excellent | Excellent |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Value | Good | Excellent |
| Open source | No | Yes |
| Best for | General teams | Budget-conscious teams |


## What I'd look for in a team password manager

Regardless of which one you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Share credentials without sending passwords over Slack or email.
2. **Role-based access\:** Employees only see the credentials they need.
3. **Easy offboarding\:** Immediately revoke access when someone leaves.
4. **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication.
5. **Audit logs\:** See who accessed or changed shared credentials.
6. **Emergency recovery\:** Have a secure process for account recovery.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

**1\. How many people are on your team?**
